tagline.zh: 不打断操作的轻量反馈条:固定定位浮于页面之上、按时长自动消失、经 role=alert 播报,只承载非关键信息。
tagline.en: Lightweight non-blocking feedback: fixed positioning over the page, auto-dismiss on a timer, announced via role=alert — for non-critical messages only.

origin.zh: 融合自两条一手范式:Ant Design message(顶部居中、默认 3s 自动消失、不打断操作)与 MUI Snackbar(仅限非关键通知、role=alert 内容容器);「不得自动消失关键信息」的规范依据来自 WAI-APG Alert 模式对 WCAG 2.2.3 的告诫(调研 07§8/§9)。
origin.en: Fused from two first-hand paradigms: Ant Design message (top-center, 3s auto-dismiss default, non-blocking) and MUI Snackbar (non-critical only, role=alert content container); the 'never auto-dismiss critical info' rule comes from the WAI-APG Alert pattern citing WCAG 2.2.3 (research 07 §8/§9).

effect.zh: 单条 toast 的停留时长,超时整块移除(antd 出场不排队原则)。默认 3000ms 对齐 AntD message.duration 默认 3(秒,0=不自动关闭);MUI 提醒 autoHideDuration 必须给足阅读处理时间——消失过快违反 WCAG 2.2.3(WAI-APG Alert 告诫)。JS 型参数,demo 订阅后驱动计时器。
effect.en: How long one toast stays before the whole block is removed (antd's no-queue-exit principle). Default 3000ms matches AntD message.duration default 3 (seconds; 0 = never auto-close); MUI warns autoHideDuration must leave enough reading time — disappearing too fast violates WCAG 2.2.3 (WAI-APG Alert). JS-type param; the demo subscribes and drives the timer.

effect.zh: 堆栈锚定的六方位(纵向 top/bottom × 横向 left/center/right)。默认 top-center 对齐 AntD message 的固定顶部居中(message.config.top 默认 8px);六方位自由组合来自 MUI Snackbar anchorOrigin 的纵横二维模型。JS 型参数,demo 订阅后切换容器对齐。
effect.en: Six anchor positions for the stack (vertical top/bottom × horizontal left/center/right). Default top-center aligns with AntD message's fixed top-center (message.config.top defaults to 8px); the 6-way free composition comes from MUI Snackbar's anchorOrigin vertical×horizontal model. JS-type param; the demo subscribes and switches the container alignment.

effect.zh: 同时并存的最大条数,超出即移除最旧一条。AntD message.config.maxCount 默认不限制(-),本 demo 为演示堆栈收敛为 1–5;默认 3 为演示取值,非任何库的官方默认(调研未证实 3 为官方值)。
effect.en: Max simultaneous toasts; the oldest is removed once exceeded. AntD message.config.maxCount defaults to unlimited (-); this demo narrows the range to 1–5, and the default 3 is a demo value, not any library's official default (3-as-default is unverified in research).

effect.zh: 入场弹簧的刚度 k(半隐式欧拉积分,m=1):ω₀=√(k/m) 越大启动越猛、到位越快,过冲比例不受影响(ζ 不变时)。默认 100 = Motion 引擎 spring.ts 源码默认 stiffness=100(调研 10 §6.3 源码逐字核验;motion.dev 文档页标注默认 1 与源码不一致,以源码为准)。参考档位(调研 10 §2.3 本地实算):700/40 ≈ 快·稳(过冲 2.7%)、300/25 ≈ 中·微弹(3.8%)、200/15 ≈ 慢·弹(14.0%)。
effect.en: Stiffness k of the entrance spring (semi-implicit Euler integration, m=1): larger ω₀=√(k/m) starts harder and arrives sooner, with the overshoot ratio unchanged (at fixed ζ). Default 100 = the Motion engine's spring.ts source default stiffness=100 (research 10 §6.3, source verified verbatim; the motion.dev docs page says 1 — the source wins). Reference presets (research 10 §2.3, locally computed): 700/40 ≈ quick-steady (2.7% overshoot), 300/25 ≈ micro-bounce (3.8%), 200/15 ≈ slow-bouncy (14.0%).

effect.zh: 入场弹簧的阻尼系数 c:ζ=c/(2√(km)) 决定过冲——默认 10 与 stiffness 100 组合得 ζ=0.5、首拍过冲约 16.3%(调研 10 §6.3 Motion 源码默认 + §4.3 实算);ζ≈1 为最快无过冲的临界阻尼(如 100/20),ζ>1 过阻尼粘滞(社区流传的 500/50 实为 ζ≈1.12 过阻尼反例,调研 10 §2.3)。c=0 永不停止(Motion 文档警告),故下限 1。
effect.en: Damping coefficient c of the entrance spring: ζ=c/(2√(km)) sets the overshoot — the default 10 with stiffness 100 gives ζ=0.5 and a first overshoot of ≈16.3% (research 10 §6.3 Motion source default + §4.3 computation); ζ≈1 is the fastest overshoot-free critical damping (e.g. 100/20), ζ>1 turns sticky (the community-circulated 500/50 is actually an overdamped ζ≈1.12 counter-example, research 10 §2.3). c=0 never settles (Motion docs warning), so the floor is 1.

note.zh: 实现只依赖 CSS 固定定位 + transform/opacity 过渡与 JS 计时/事件,均为 Baseline 能力;prefers-reduced-motion 自 2020-01 起全浏览器可用(调研 07§37)。
note.en: Implementation only needs CSS fixed positioning + transform/opacity transitions and JS timers/events, all Baseline; prefers-reduced-motion is supported across browsers since 2020-01 (research 07 §37).

fallback.zh: 不支持 transform 过渡的旧环境退化为直接出现/消失(无动效不影响信息传达);JS 禁用时 toast 无法触发,关键信息必须另有页面内持久承载,不能只靠 toast。
fallback.en: Without transform transitions the toast simply appears/disappears with no motion — the message itself is unaffected; with JS disabled toasts cannot fire, so critical information must also live in persistent in-page UI, never in a toast alone.

use.zh: 保存成功、复制成功等非关键过程反馈(不打断操作)
带撤销动作的轻反馈(Gmail 式『已发送+撤销』)
use.en: Light feedback with an undo action (Gmail-style 'Sent + Undo')

use.zh: 批量操作结果汇总(『已归档 12 项』)

avoid.zh: 关键/必须处理的信息——走 Dialog(alertdialog)或持久 banner(APG:自动消失太快违反 WCAG 2.2.3)
avoid.en: Critical, must-act messages — use Dialog (alertdialog) or a persistent banner (APG: too-fast auto-dismiss violates WCAG 2.2.3)

avoid.zh: 错误表单校验——错误要紧贴字段持久呈现(NN/g:勿用浮层报错)
avoid.en: Form validation errors — keep errors persistent next to the field (NN/g: no floating-layer-only errors)

avoid.zh: 长时间进度(>10s)——改用进度条 + 可中断途径(NN/g 三限)
avoid.en: Long progress (>10s) — use a progress bar with an interrupt path (NN/g response-time limits)

avoid.zh: 大量堆叠刷屏——MUI 明确不鼓励堆叠多条 Snackbar
avoid.en: Stacking floods — MUI explicitly discourages stacking multiple Snackbars

a11y.zh: 每条 toast 容器用 role=alert,动态插入时多数屏幕阅读器自动播报(WAI-APG Alert);不得夺取键盘焦点,要打断用户就改用 alertdialog;必须提供 Esc 关闭(MUI Snackbar 无障碍要求);自动消失仅限非关键信息,消失过快违反 WCAG 2.2.3、频繁打断违反 2.2.4(APG Alert 告诫)。
a11y.en: Give each toast a role=alert container — dynamic insertion is auto-announced by most screen readers (WAI-APG Alert); never steal keyboard focus, use alertdialog when you must interrupt; Esc must dismiss (MUI Snackbar a11y requirement); auto-dismiss only for non-critical info — too fast violates WCAG 2.2.3, frequent interruptions violate 2.2.4 (APG Alert).

goal.zh: 复刻一套全局轻提示:按钮触发后浮层按锚定位堆叠出现,到时长整块自动消失,支持 maxCount 截断最旧条目与 Esc 关闭。
goal.en: Replicate a toast system: buttons spawn floating notifications that stack at the anchored position, auto-dismiss wholesale after the duration, honor maxCount by dropping the oldest, and dismiss on Esc.

acceptance.zh: 每条 toast 用 role=alert 且不夺取焦点;Esc 可关闭
acceptance.en: Each toast uses role=alert without stealing focus; Esc dismisses

acceptance.zh: duration/maxCount/placement 严格使用参数快照值
acceptance.en: duration/maxCount/placement use the exact parameter snapshot values

acceptance.zh: 计时超时后整块移除(出场不排队);入场为物理弹簧(半隐式欧拉,m=1),stiffness/damping 严格取参数快照值,从自身高度 200% 外滑入,卡片层叠 0.35s cubic-bezier(.21,1.02,.73,1) 缩放淡入(react-hot-toast 同款)
acceptance.en: Expiry removes the whole block at once (no exit queue); the entrance is a physics spring (semi-implicit Euler, m=1) sliding in from 200% of its own height with exact snapshot stiffness/damping, while the card layer cross-fades/scales over 0.35s cubic-bezier(.21,1.02,.73,1) (react-hot-toast's curve)

acceptance.zh: 命中 prefers-reduced-motion 时取消滑入动画
acceptance.en: Disable the slide-in animation under prefers-reduced-motion

acceptance.zh: 只承载非关键信息;关键操作结果另行持久呈现
acceptance.en: Non-critical messages only; critical outcomes get persistent treatment elsewhere
